kamloops.title: Okanagan communities rally around Bald Range wildfire evacuees
kamloops.description: For many evacuees, the immediate challenge was finding somewhere to sleep, something to eat and the basic necessities they had suddenly left behind.

kamloops.title: As wildfires destroy homes, should B.C. make FireSmart principles mandatory?
kamloops.description: Experts say practical measures to keep your home from catching fire are proven to work — and point to the communities have built back smarter.

kamloops.title: How art is helping Summerland evacuees of B.C.'s Bald Range wildfire
kamloops.description: At a comfort centre for evacuees of the Bald Range Wildfire, art is an escape. Pens, paper and paint are placed on placed on tables, along with stickers and buttons for Summerland evacuees. It is part of an art therapy initiative by the Penticton & District Community Arts council.

prince-george.title: How studying driver behaviour could make wildfire evacuations in northern B.C. safer
prince-george.description: A UNBC PhD candidate is studying how drivers respond during simulated wildfire evacuations on Highway 97 north of Prince George. The research will help build a traffic model that could help emergency planners understand congestion, travel times and road closures before an evacuation happens.

prince-george.title: B.C. farmer who fled wildfire teams up with chef on sauces to support other producers
prince-george.description: A B.C. chef and a local farmer who lost his home to the raging Bald Range wildfire have teamed up on a project to support other producers hit hard by fires this summer.

southeast.title: Should powerboats be allowed on Wasa Lake in the East Kootenay? New report raises questions
southeast.description: A new assessment says Wasa Lake is at high risk from powerboating, as local groups ask for science-based rules to protect water quality.

all.title: B.C. offering free N95 masks for B.C. Interior as wildfire smoke persists
all.description: The wildfire service says temperatures are expected to slightly rise across central and southern regions while northwest areas will see a slight dip in temperatures.

all.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 17
all.description: The mayor of Summerland, B.C., says that damage assessments have been completed as more of his community's residents return, after being forced to flee due to the out-of-control Bald Range wildfire.

all.title: Meteorologists are forecasting a 'super' El Niño. What does that mean for B.C.?
all.description: The El Niño weather pattern can affect temperature and precipitation across North America, but what does it mean for British Columbia? And will it affect the wildfire situation?

all.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 16
all.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service (BCWS) says it's keeping an eye on an unstable weather pattern that could produce more wildfires in the southern half of the province on Sunday, even as evacuation orders are slowly lifted near some of the province's most concerning fires.

all.title: Fort St. John mayor calls for gang task force support after surge in targeted shootings
all.description: Fort St. John Mayor Lilia Hansen wants B.C.'s gang task force to intervene after three shootings in less than a month near local schools.

all.title: Homes across B.C. have been decimated by wildfires. Here's what to know about your insurance
all.description: Hundreds of structures have been lost to wildfires so far this year.  Experts say even those who are fully insured will face a long, complex process as they begin to rebuild.

all.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 15
all.description: Thousands of residents forced to flee their homes due to wildfires across B.C. are returning Saturday, and a major highway is set to reopen as some conditions improve.
